theme.description: Premium corporate/hospitality-inspired theme imitating the luxurious, editorial feel of the St Regis hotel. Dominated by a cinematic black canvas, refined grey typography, and elegant warm gold/yellow accents.

hierarchy.eyebrow: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#E9B949] font-medium

typography.rules: Never use Inter or default generic fonts for headings. Use wide tracking for uppercase labels and tight tracking for large headings. Keep weights thin or light for editorial feel.

layout_strategies.bento_editorial: Mix of dense content grids and wide cinematic images. Use thin 1px borders (#27272A) for separation instead of heavy cards.
layout_strategies.asymmetry: Offset text blocks from images. Leave breathing room. Never center everything.
layout_strategies.thin_rules: Use thin horizontal and vertical rules (borders) mimicking high-end print magazines. A 1px subtle yellow line `border-[#E9B949]/30` as a section divider is encouraged.

header.style: fixed w-full z-50 bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E9B949]/20 transition-all duration-500
header.elements: Brand text left, centered nav links (hidden on mobile), language switcher (BM / EN) and minimal CTA right. Thin golden underline on link hover.

hero.style: h-screen min-h-[800px] relative flex items-center justify-center text-center
hero.content: Cinematic dark background image, uppercase eyebrow, massive serif H1 'Building Excellence. Engineering Futures.', minimal gold-accented call to action button.

buttons.primary: px-8 py-3 border border-[#E9B949] text-[#E9B949] hover:bg-[#E9B949] hover:text-[#050505] transition-colors duration-300 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs
buttons.text_link: text-white hover:text-[#E9B949] relative after:content-[''] after:absolute after:w-full after:scale-x-0 hover:after:scale-x-100 after:h-[1px] after:bottom-0 after:left-0 after:bg-[#E9B949] after:origin-bottom-right hover:after:origin-bottom-left after:transition-transform after:duration-300

cards.service: group relative overflow-hidden border border-[#27272A] p-8 hover:border-[#E9B949]/50 transition-colors duration-500 bg-[#0F0F0F]

footer.content: Minimalist grid, large brand typography, thin rules between columns.

motion.general: Slow, deliberate, cinematic. No fast bouncing.
motion.reveal: Use framer-motion for smooth 1s opacity & slight y-axis translation reveals on scroll.
motion.hover: Subtle image scaling (`group-hover:scale-105`), border color transitions.

content_structure.bilingual_support: Implement a simple language state (BM/EN). Use a context or just inline conditional rendering to switch text. Default to EN.
